sections.heading: How to Play Vengeance
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="How to Play Vengeance"][color=c12]Vengeance Demon Hunter Rotation in Midnight Season 2[/color][/h2]
Vengeance Demon Hunters operate on a priority list builder-spender system. Depending on the situation, you will prioritize either building or spending one of our two resources while trying to avoid overcapping either of them. You generally want to abide by the following rules:

[wrapper width=1100px][box border=true]
[center][table style=grid]
[tr][td]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=spell_shadow_soulgem size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Generators are key:[/color][/b] While in most cases there is a fairly smooth flow between building and spending, whenever there is a priority conflict, it is more important to keep your generators on cooldown due to procs associated with [spell=263642] and [spell=219741] generation for the Hero trees. [span class=tip tooltip=OverviewGenerators][symbol=wow-atlas-quest-wrapper-turnin][/span]
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=inv_icon_shadowcouncilorb_purple size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Prioritize Spenders by Soul cost:[/color][/b] You should always try to use Soul spenders with as many Souls as possible. This gives the maximum efficiency per global used.[span class=tip tooltip=OverviewSpenders][symbol=wow-atlas-quest-wrapper-turnin][/span]
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_demonhunter_soulcleave size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Avoid Overcapping Resources when Possible:[/color][/b] While it is sometimes inevitable due to multiple generators coming off cooldown and priority conflict, try to build and spend in waves to manage resources. [span class=tip tooltip=OverviewOvercap][symbol=wow-atlas-quest-wrapper-turnin][/span]
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[hr]
[table]
	[tr]
	[td width=6%][icon name=ability_demonhunter_fierybrand size=medium type=round color=c12 inline=true][/icon][/td]
	[td][b][color=c12]Press Cooldowns as they become Available:[/color][/b] Maximize cooldown efficiency by constantly using abilities as they become available. Procs can get wasted if your abilities are sitting off cooldown for long periods. [span class=tip tooltip=OverviewCDs][symbol=wow-atlas-quest-wrapper-turnin][/span]
	[/td][/tr]
[/table]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[/center]
[/box][/wrapper]
[pad]
[center][cta-button guide=32787 icon=ability_demonhunter_spectank]Vengeance Demon Hunter Starter Guide[/cta-button][/center]

sections.heading: Rotation Priority
sections.body:
[h2 type=bar toc="Rotation Priority"][icon name=ability_demonhunter_spectank type=round size=medium inline=true color=c12][/icon] Best Vengeance Demon Hunter Rotation[/h2]
For all forms of content, Vengeance follows a priority list of what spells to cast. This priority is based on dual-resource builders and spenders with cooldowns interspersed.

Below, we break down the main priority lists for Vengeance Demon Hunter: Single-Target Rotation, AoE Rotation, and your opener sequence.
[wrapper width=70%][center][box border=true]
	[center][large][b][color=white]Hero Talent Master Switches[/color][/b][/large]
	[pad]
	You can use the master switches below to flip the [b][i]entire page's[/i][/b] options to your selected choice.[/center]

	[center]
	[wrapper width=95%]
		[grid width=95%]
			[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=inv_12_dh_void_ability_voidfall enable-options="AN-Op,AN-ST,AN-AoE" color=paladin]Annihilator[/display-group]
			[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=inv_ability_aldrachireaverdemonhunter_reaversglaive enable-options="AR-Op,AR-ST,AR-AoE" color=druid]Aldrachi Reaver[/display-group]
			[display-group="HeroMaster" icon=misc_rnrredxbutton color=shaman]Clear Selections[/display-group]
		[/grid]
	[/wrapper]
	[/center]
[/box][/center][/wrapper]
[br]
[tabs name="Rotations" uniform=true]

[tab name="Single-Target Priority" icon=spell_holy_divinespirit]
	[h3 toc="Single Target Priority" type=bar][color=c12] Best Vengeance Demon Hunter Single Target Rotation[/color][/h3]
	[pad]
Vengeance plays around a priority list rather than a strict rotation. This means with each GCD we go top to bottom on a list ordered by relative power and use the first ability on that list which meets our conditions. [span display-options="!(AN-ST)&!(AR-ST)"]Due to each Hero Talent having a minor impact on your priority, you can use the buttons below to switch between them.[/span][span display-options="AN-ST"]With [symbol=wow-hero-talent-annihilator] [b][color=c2]Annihilator[/color][/b] selected, the priority is as follows:[/span][span display-options="AR-ST"]With [symbol=wow-hero-talent-aldrachi-reaver] [b][color=c11]Aldrachi Reaver[/color][/b] selected, the priority is as follows:[/span]

sections.heading: Major Cooldowns
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Major Cooldowns" type=bar][color=c12][icon name=ability_demonhunter_spectank type=round size=medium inline=true color=c12][/icon] Vengeance Demon Hunter Major Cooldowns[/color][/h2]
[h3 type=bar]Offensive Cooldowns[/h3]
Using Offensive Cooldowns as they become available is generally the best option.
[table class=grid]
[tr]
[td background=c12][b]Spell[/b][/td]
[td background=c12][b]Cooldown[/b][/td]
[td background=c12][b]When to use[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=212084][/td]
[td]40 seconds (28-34 seconds with [spell=389708])[/td]
[td]Generally on cooldown. If you have [spell=389220] and [spell=389732], sync it with one cast of [spell=204021].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=207407][/td]
[td]1 minute[/td]
[td]On cooldown, with fewer than 3 souls. If you have [spell=389220] talented, sync it with [spell=204021].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=390163][/td]
[td]1 minute[/td]
[td]On cooldown, ideally synced with [spell=204021] if talented into [spell=389220].[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h3 type=bar]Defensive Cooldowns[/h3]
None of our defensive cooldowns are particularly powerful, so in general we recommend maximizing usage by using them as they become available. If you aren't actively Tanking, you can hold for a short period.
[table class=grid]
[tr]
[td background=c12][b]Spell[/b][/td]
[td background=c12][b]Cooldown[/b][/td]
[td background=c12][b]When to use[/b][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=187827][/td]
[td]2 minutes, reduced by some talents[/td]
[td]On cooldown, but not if you are already in [spell=187827] from another proc and it has more than 5 seconds remaining, as it will overwrite the duration instead of extending.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=212084][/td]
[td]40 seconds (28-34 seconds with [spell=389708])[/td]
[td]Generally on cooldown when you are below 70% health. If you have [spell=389220] and [spell=389732], sync it with one cast of [spell=204021].[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=204021][/td]
[td]1 minute (48 seconds with [spell=389732])[/td]
[td]On cooldown. If you have a large tankbuster coming soon, you can hold it for up to 10 seconds. If running [spell=389732], sync one charge with offensive cooldowns.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=203720][/td]
[td]20 seconds (reduced by haste)[/td]
[td]Whenever you do not have any other defensives active, or if your charges would fully recharge before any other active defensives run out.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][spell=196718][/td]
[td]5 minutes (3 with [spell=389783])[/td]
[td]On cooldown as much as possible. Hold for any group damage phases, especially if there are multiple hits, or pulls with many adds.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

sections.heading: Advanced Tips
sections.body:
[h2 toc="Advanced Tips" type=bar][color=c12][icon name=Inv_artifact_tome01 type=round size=medium inline=true color=c12][/icon] Vengeance Demon Hunter Advanced Tips[/color][/h2]
There is very little optimization for Vengeance after the Midnight pruning.

[pad]

[tabs name="advanced" uniform=true iconborders=true]
[tab name="Fracture" icon=ability_creature_felsunder]
	[h3 type=bar toc=false][color=c12] Fracture [/color][/h3]
	Fracture optimization is a minor optimization that can be managed when playing [symbol=wow-hero-talent-annihilator] [color=whisper]Annihilator[/color]. When you are at full stacks of Voidfall or in the process of spending them, avoid pressing Fracture since you cannot generate. That means you want to prioritize it more heavily when you are about to proc the third stack.
[/tab]
[/tabs]
[pad]

Our Vengeance Demon Hunter guides are always updated with the latest information from in-game experience, simulations, and logs. Make sure to check our changelog for this page by clicking on [b]View Changelog[/b] in the Quick Facts column or on the book icon at the top of the page. If you are interested in more in-depth Vengeance Demon Hunter guides for [b]Midnight Season 2[/b], make sure to browse the [i]Navigation Bar[/i] at the top of the page, along with our list of [b]Related Guides[/b] just beneath the [i]Table of Contents[/i].





[tooltip name=OverviewGenerators][i]Builder[/i] Priority is [spell=263642] at 2 stacks \u279c [spell=258920] \u279c [spell=204596] \u279c [spell=390163].[/tooltip]

[tooltip name=OverviewSpenders][i]Spender[/i] Priority is [spell=247454] with 6 Souls \u279c [spell=228477] with 1-3 Souls \u279c [spell=212084] \u279c [spell=228477] with 0 Souls.[/tooltip]

[tooltip name=OverviewOvercap]While builders tend to take priority, spenders are important for a smooth rotation. Try to weave them in to prevent overcapping resources.[/tooltip]

[tooltip name=OverviewCDs]You want to be pressing something every GCD, and abilities with cooldowns are more efficient.[/tooltip]

[tooltip name=NotesHighlight]Note![/tooltip]

[tooltip name=Pool]This allows you to cast [spell=247454] followed by [spell=228477] immediately when you get 3 stacks.[/tooltip]

[tooltip name=VoidfallBug]There is a bug that grants an extra [spell=1256306] due to the delay on dropping Meteors when spent with [spell=247454].[/tooltip]
